request: Issue #10 verify actual shared Terminal bootstrap log result socket and bounded-host health after PR218

bounded_host_request.command: sh -c 'cat /tmp/gace-result-sink-bootstrap-20261014.log; echo RESULT_SOCKET; test -S /run/gace/servercore-result.sock && echo PRESENT; echo SINK_SERVICE; systemctl --user is-active gace-servercore-result-sink.service; echo CONTAINER; docker inspect -f "{{.State.Running}} {{if .State.Health}}{{.State.Health.Status}}{{end}}" server-core-bounded-host'
